settings.question: Which camera should I start with?
settings.answer:
For an easy everyday companion, explore our point-and-shoots. If you want to learn focus and exposure with more hands-on control, look at 35mm SLR cameras. Medium format offers a larger negative and a more deliberate pace.

Use the camera finder above to narrow by type and budget. Every camera is different, so read its listing or ask us for a recommendation before buying.

settings.question: Do used cameras and lenses have a warranty?
settings.answer:
Used cameras and lenses include a 90-day limited warranty from the date of purchase, except equipment graded AS-IS. During the warranty period, Coastal Film Lab may repair or replace eligible equipment with a similar or comparable item at its discretion.

User-inflicted damage, misuse, abuse, and neglect are excluded. Proof of purchase and notice within the warranty period are required. Read the complete warranty and exclusions.

settings.question: What does the condition grade mean?
settings.answer:
Our grades run from Mint through Excellent, Good, One-Off, and AS-IS. They describe wear, function, and optical condition. One-Off items have missing functions described in their listings; AS-IS equipment may be untested or nonfunctional and has no returns or warranty.

The product description is essential: read it for the individual camera’s condition, included items, and known issues. See the full grading definitions.

settings.question: Does the camera include a lens, film, or batteries?
settings.answer:
It depends on the individual listing. Check the description for exactly what is included, the film format, and any battery requirements. A lens is included only when the listing says so.

If you are choosing a separate lens, confirm the mount and compatibility before purchasing. We can help check your setup.

settings.question: Where does your camera gear come from?
settings.answer: Our camera equipment comes from a very diverse range of sources. Most items are directly purchased from the original owners who have lovingly cared for them over the years and are simply ready for them to find new owners who will enjoy them. Additionally, we do source hard to find cameras directly from used camera stores in Japan and Europe for items that are hard to find in the states. Our global network of experienced camera hunters seek out hidden gems, looking for the most interesting cameras they can find for our store. With all these sources combined we're able to offer a vast range of cameras to fit almost any taste!

settings.question: Can you help me choose before I buy?
settings.answer:
Absolutely. Tell us your budget, the kind of photographs you want to make, and whether you prefer something simple or hands-on. We can help with camera choices, film formats, and lens compatibility.

Contact the lab or visit us at 1704 N Nebraska Ave, Tampa, Florida.
